sloka: स दर्भं संस्तराद् गृह्य ब्रह्मास्त्रेण ह्ययोजयः ।स दीप्त इव कालाग्निर्जज्वालाभिमुखः खगम् ।। ५.६७.१२ ।।।।
transliteration: sa darbhaṁ saṁstarād gṛhya brahmāstreṇa hyayojayaḥ ।sa dīpta iva kālāgnirjajvālābhimukhaḥ khagam ।। 5.67.12 ।।।।

translations.english: 'You took out a blade of grass from your mat and chanted the mantra to invoke the weapon of Brahma (Brahmastra) and hurled it on the crow. It blazed like the fire of the doom's day.
